turns.content:
[College group, 9:14 pm]
Sameer: [reel: rooftop infinity pool, Dubai skyline] good times 🥂
Tushar: bhai ke paas toh aadha Gurgaon hai ab, lifestyle dekho
Sameer: expanding soon boys, watch this space 😎
---
[DM, 11:52 pm]
Sameer: Faisal, chhota sa kaam. ek dost ke liye puchh raha hoon — tumhari company mein koi opening hai? operations ya general management side. 15-18 LPA bracket chalega.
Sameer: woh isi mahine move karna chah raha hai. solid banda hai, saalon apna setup chalaya hai.
Sameer: aur yaar group mein iska zikr mat karna, woh private rakhta hai yeh sab.
Faisal: arre haan haan pakka, Monday ko HR se puchhta hoon 👍
---
[College group, agle din, 1:30 pm]
Faisal: reunion ka venue toh set hai phir — Sameer bhai sponsor karenge, business boom kar raha hai 😂
Tushar: 😂😂 gym king
Sameer: 👍
---
[DM, teen din baad]
Faisal: bhai, HR ne dost ka CV manga hai, bhej doge?
Faisal: hello? bhai?

---
1. Sameer ke DM mein "dost" kaun hai aur tumhe kaise pata? Third-person wala frame Sameer ke liye kya kaam kar raha hai — yahi costume kyun?
2. Agle din Faisal ke group message ne Sameer ke saath kya kiya, trace karo. DM chup kyun ho gaya — thumbs-up, joke, aur teen din ki silence ko jodo.
3. Woh DM likho jo Faisal ko ab bhejna chahiye, bilkul waisa jaisa bhejna chahiye — jo Sameer ko asli help dilaye bina usse kuch bhi admit karwaye.

1. **Sameer ke DM mein “dost” Sameer khud hi lag raha hai.**  
   Kaise pata?  
   - Sameer ne group mein image banayi hai: Dubai pool, Tushar ka “aadha Gurgaon” joke, aur Sameer ka reply **“expanding soon boys”** — matlab woh publicly successful/expanding businessman dikh raha hai.  
   - Uske turant baad woh privately Faisal se **operations/general management job**, **15–18 LPA**, **this month move** wali opening maangta hai.  
   - Woh kehta hai: **“saalon apna setup chalaya hai”** — yeh Sameer ke “business boom” image se match karta hai.  
   - Sabse important: **“group mein iska zikr mat karna, woh private rakhta hai yeh sab.”** Agar dost koi aur hota, toh itni urgency, itna secrecy aur phir CV bhejne mein silence samajhna mushkil hota.  

   **Third-person frame Sameer ke liye face-saving costume hai.**  
   Woh seedha bol nahi pa raha: “Mujhe job chahiye.” Kyunki usne group mein wealth/expansion ka persona maintain kiya hua hai. “Dost” bolne se:  
   - rejection ka risk kam lagta hai,  
   - status bachta hai,  
   - Faisal ko help ke liye pressure hota hai bina Sameer ko vulnerable dikhaye,  
   - agar baat leak ho jaye toh woh keh sakta hai “mere dost ke liye tha.”  

2. **Agle din Faisal ke group message ne Sameer ko public frame mein trap/lock kar diya.**  
   Trace:  
   - DM mein Sameer ne bola: **“group mein iska zikr mat karna.”**  
   - Faisal ne exactly opposite kiya: group mein bola, **“Sameer bhai sponsor karenge, business boom kar raha hai.”**  
   - Isne Sameer ke public image ko aur strong kar diya: woh ab sirf “expanding” nahi, group ke saamne **sponsor-worthy businessman** ban gaya.  
   - Tushar ne joke kiya: **“gym king”**, aur Sameer ne sirf **👍** diya. Yeh thumbs-up Sameer ka public agreement hai — woh image ko reject nahi kar pa raha.  

   **DM chup isliye ho gaya kyunki Sameer ab awkward position mein aa gaya.**  
   Agar woh Faisal ko CV bhejta, toh private job-search expose ho sakti thi. Agar bolta “job chahiye,” toh group wali “business boom/sponsor” image toot jaati. Isliye silence.  

   Teen din baad Faisal ka **“hello? bhai?”** Sameer ke avoidance ko expose kar raha hai: Sameer ne help maangi, Faisal ne HR tak baat le gayi, aur Sameer ab CV bhejne se bach raha hai kyunki woh apna asli position admit nahi karna chahta.

3. **Faisal ko ab yeh DM bhejna chahiye:**

> Bhai, HR ko bas CV chahiye — naam/company details etc. sab tum dono handle kar lena. Main sirf internal referral/forward kar dunga, zyada kuch explain nahi karna.  
>   
> Agar abhi timing right nahi hai toh koi issue nahi, main HR ko politely bol dunga ki role暂时 hold kar lein. Tum bas ek baar bata do: CV bhejna hai ya filhal hold karna hai? No pressure.
